units: <cite ref="Mishnah Moed Katan 2:4">M. Kat. II, 4</cite> <he>לצ׳ המועד</he> if required for use during the festival; <he>לצ׳ המוכר</he> if the seller is in need of money.

<cite ref="Pesachim 5b">Pes. 5ᵇ</cite> we do not say, <he>הואיל והותרה … לצ׳ … שלא לצ׳</he> since lighting a fire is permitted (on the Holy Day) for the need of the day, it may also be permitted where it is not needed for the day. Y. Naz. III, beg. 54ᶜ <he>הבערה לצ׳ יצאת</he> the prohibition to start a fire on the Sabbath (<cite ref="Exodus 35:3">Ex. XXXV, 3</cite>) is specified for a purpose (for interpretation).
<cite ref="Shabbat 131b:14">Sabb. 131ᵇ</cite> <he>צ׳ גבוה</he> needed for the altar (v. <cite ref="C00053"><he>גָּבוֹהַּ</he></cite>).
Bets. 21ᵇ עושה אדם כל צָרְכוֹ בפת man may use a loaf of bread for whatever he may need (not only for eating); Ber. 50ᵇ צָרְכָיו (pl.).

Snh. 88ᵇ שלא שמשו כל צָרְכָן who had not attended their teachers sufficiently; Y. ib. I, 19ᶜ כצוֹרְכָן; a. v. fr.—Euphemisms: Y. Keth. V, 30ᵇ היתה עושה צוֹרְכָהּ באחרים she gratified her desire with other men; Gen. R. s. 52 צָרָכֶיהָ (pl.).
Y. Ber. III, 6ᶜ אעשה צָרְכִי I will gratify my desire; a. fr.—Pl. צֳרָכִים, constr. צוֹרְכֵי, צָרְכֵי.
<cite ref="Berakhot 46b">Ber. 46ᵇ</cite> <he>צ׳ סעודה</he> the requirements of a meal.
<cite ref="Mishnah Shabbat 19:2">Sabb. XIX, 2</cite> (<cite ref="Shabbat 133a:1">133ᵃ</cite>, sq.) <he>כל צ׳ מילה</he> all preparations needed for circumcision.
<cite ref="Mishnah Shekalim 4:7">Shek. IV, 7</cite> <he>ימכרו לצ׳ עולות</he> (Y. ed. <he>לצְרִיכֵי</he>) shall be sold for the purposes of (to buy with the money realized) burnt-offerings.
<cite ref="Beitzah 28b:6">Bets. 28ᵇ</cite> <he>לכם לכל צָרְכֵיכֶם</he> ‘for you’ (<cite ref="Exodus 12:16">Ex. XII, 16</cite>), for all your needs of the day.
<cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Berakhot 5:2:8">Y. Ber. V, 9ᵇ</cite> bot. <he>שואל צָרְכָיו וכ׳</he> inserts the prayer for his individual needs in the benediction ‘Hearer of Prayers’.

<cite ref="Vayikra Rabbah 34">Lev. R. s. 34</cite>, end (ref. to <cite ref="Isaiah 58:13">Is. LVIII, 13</cite>) <he>מכאן … לתבוע צרכיו בשבת</he> from this we learn that man must not pray for his individual wants on the Sabbath; a. fr.—
<cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Chagigah 2:2:7">Y. Ḥag. II, 78ᵃ</cite> top <he>עשה צרכיו עמה</he> had marital connection with her, v. supra.

<cite ref="Yalkut Shimoni on Nach 927:2">Yalk. Job 927</cite> (ref. to <cite ref="Job 41:7">Job XLI, 7</cite>) <he>סוגר כל חותמות הצרכים</he> he (the Leviathan) closes all the seals of needs (all his own orifices of discharge, contrad. to <he>כל חותמות המְצָרְכִים</he> all the seals of those that have needs (causes their obstruction); a. fr.
